root.label: Red Sox activate Roman Anthony and Trevor Story for Yankees finale

events.label: Red Sox activate Roman Anthony and Trevor Story for Yankees finale

slots.name: Anthony games missed
slots.sentence: Anthony was sidelined for 100 games by a sprained right wrist.

slots.name: Story games missed
slots.sentence: Story missed 92 games because of a sports hernia.

slots.name: wild card deficit
slots.sentence: The Red Sox entered play on Sunday three games behind the Yankees for the top AL wild card.

slots.name: Story batting average
slots.sentence: Story was batting .206 with three homers and 19 RBIs in 41 games before going on the IL on May 16.

slots.name: Anthony rehab homers
slots.sentence: In eight rehab games with Double-A Portland and Triple-A Worcester, Anthony went 7 for 25 with two homers and seven RBIs.

slots.name: Anthony rehab RBIs
slots.sentence: In eight rehab games with Double-A Portland and Triple-A Worcester, Anthony went 7 for 25 with two homers and seven RBIs.

slots.name: Anthony season average
slots.sentence: He batted .292 with eight homers and 32 RBIs before he was sidelined by an oblique injury for the rest of the season.

slots.name: Story rehab batting
slots.sentence: He went 6 for 35 in 10 rehab games for Worcester.

slots.name: Story homers before IL
slots.sentence: He led the Red Sox with 25 homers last season and tied a career high by appearing in 157 games after playing 163 games over the first three seasons of a six-year, $140 million contract .
